extensionDescription.message: Manage server-side filters using Sieve scripts.

addServerAutodetectHint.message: Enter the server name and address. Manage Sieve will look for a JMAP Sieve service there.

configureAutodetectHint.message: Enter the server address. Manage Sieve will detect the JMAP Sieve settings for it.

serverAddressRequired.message: Enter a server address to continue.

jmapUnavailable.message: No JMAP Sieve service was found at this address. Check the server address, or enter the connection settings manually below.

unsupportedProvider.message: This server needs a connection type that Manage Sieve does not support. Enter the JMAP connection settings manually below.

addServerHint.message: Add a Sieve server that is not tied to an existing Thunderbird account.

welcomeBannerTitle.message: Welcome to the Manage Sieve Extension!

welcomeBannerMessage.message: Manage Sieve helps you work with server-side mail filters directly in Thunderbird. Connect a Sieve service, edit your scripts, validate changes, and choose the active script for each account.

welcomeBannerGettingStartedMessage.message: To get started, configure the Sieve server for one of your existing accounts, or use the + button to manually add a server.

welcomeBannerReturnMessage.message: You can return here anytime from Thunderbird's Tools menu.

displayNameDescription.message: The name shown in the Manage Sieve sidebar.

serverAddressDescription.message: A host name or full JMAP session URL. Host names use the JMAP well-known URL by default.

authTypeDescription.message: How the JMAP server authenticates requests.

tokenDescription.message: A bearer token for JMAP requests.

usernameDescription.message: The login name used for Basic authentication.

passwordDescription.message: The password or app password for the selected user name.

oauthIssuerUrlDescription.message: The OAuth authorization server issuer used to discover login endpoints.

oauthAuthorizationUrlDescription.message: The endpoint opened in a login window to authorize Manage Sieve.

oauthTokenUrlDescription.message: The endpoint used to exchange and refresh OAuth access tokens.

oauthClientIdDescription.message: The public OAuth client identifier. The default is open.

oauthScopeDescription.message: The OAuth permissions requested for JMAP Sieve access.

oauthMissingEndpointConfiguration.message: OAuth issuer URL or manual authorization and token URLs are required.

oauthIncompleteManualEndpoints.message: OAuth authorization URL and token URL are both required when entering endpoints manually.

oauthStateMismatch.message: The OAuth response did not match the request state.

oauthIssuerMismatch.message: OAuth response issuer did not match the configured OAuth Issuer URL. Expected $EXPECTED$, got $ACTUAL$. Update OAuth Issuer URL to match the authorization server issuer.

oauthMissingCode.message: The OAuth response did not include an authorization code.

deleteScriptConfirm.message: Delete the script $SCRIPT$? This cannot be undone

deleteActiveScriptDisabled.message: Active scripts cannot be deleted. Deactivate the script to delete it

scriptSaveTimeout.message: Saving timed out. The server did not respond.

validationFailed.message: The server reported a Sieve validation error.

scriptNameAlreadyExists.message: A script with this name already exists

scriptActivationNotConfirmed.message: The server did not report the selected script as active.

scriptDeactivationNotConfirmed.message: The server still reports an active script.

emptyHint.message: Select an account, script, or configuration item.
